body.statement: When \(d=0\), the capsule accepts immediately, selects two disjoint uniform fixed-size samples, labels them by the arm-swap coin, and assigns independent fair coins to the remaining units.  Its raw estimator is the difference of the corresponding endpoint sample means, its Rao--Blackwellization has worst-case risk \(O(n^{-1})\), and the unrestricted minimax risk satisfies \(R_2(G)=\Theta(n^{-1})\).
body.proof_tex:
When \(d=0\), \(N_G[i]=\{i\}\), and for every \(k\)-set \(A\) one has \(F_G(A)=V\setminus A\).  Since \(k\le n/4\), every trial is accepted and \(C\) is a uniform \(k\)-subset of the complement of \(A\).  The arm swap makes each of \(T,C_0\) marginally uniform among \(k\)-subsets, and they are disjoint.  The remaining \(n-2k\) units receive independent fair coins by \(\text{def:reservoir-capsule}\).

Here \(\pi_{(i,a)}=k/n\), and \(\text{def:raw-estimator}\) becomes
\[
\widetilde\tau_G=\frac1k\sum_{i\in T}y_{i1}-\frac1k\sum_{i\in C_0}y_{i0}. \tag{27}
\]
Each term in (27) is an unbiased simple-random-sample mean.  For a fixed vector \((x_i)\) and a uniform \(k\)-subset \(S\), direct inclusion-probability algebra gives
\[
\operatorname{Var}\!\left(k^{-1}\sum_{i\in S}x_i\right)
=\frac{n-k}{k(n-1)}\left\{\frac1n\sum_i(x_i-\bar x)^2\right\}. \tag{28}
\]
The endpoint moment bounds make each brace in (28) at most one.  Applying \(\operatorname{Var}(U-V)\le2\operatorname{Var}(U)+2\operatorname{Var}(V)\), and then Rao--Blackwell variance reduction from \(\text{lem:exact-risk-certificate}\), gives
\[
\sup_{y\in\mathcal M_2(G)}
\mathbb E[(\widehat\tau_G-\tau_G)^2\mid G]
\le \frac{4(n-k)}{k(n-1)}=O(n^{-1}),                           \tag{29}
\]
because \(k/n\to\log(2)/32>0\).

For the matching lower bound, every assignment exposes exactly one endpoint per unit, so the two exposure counts sum to \(n\) and their minimum is at most \(t=\lceil n/2\rceil\).  Independently in each arm, draw a fair sign \(B_a\), and conditional on it draw independent endpoint signs \(\xi_{ia}\) having mean \(B_a/(2\sqrt t)\).  This prior is supported on the endpoint \(L^2\) ball because \(\xi_{ia}^2=1\).  Define each non-endpoint potential outcome to be zero; since \(N_G[i]=\{i\}\), this produces an ANI schedule.  If the less-exposed arm has \(m\le t\) observations, the affinity between the laws of those observations under \(B_a=1\) and \(B_a=-1\) is
\[
\left(1-\frac1{4t}\right)^{m/2}.
\]
Cauchy--Schwarz therefore bounds their total variation by
\[
\sqrt{1-\left(1-\frac1{4t}\right)^m}\le\frac12.
\]
The expected posterior variance of \(B_a\) is consequently at least \(1/2\).  At least \(n-t\ge(n-1)/2\) endpoint signs in that arm remain unobserved, so the posterior variance of their contribution to the arm mean is at least
\[
\frac{(n-t)^2}{n^2}\frac1{4t}\frac12\ge\frac{c}{n}.
\]
Conditional expectation minimizes squared error; hence every outcome-independent design and every estimator has Bayes, and therefore worst-case, risk at least \(c/n\).  Thus \(R_2(G)\ge c/n\); (29) and \(\text{def:minimax-risk}\) give \(R_2(G)\le C/n\).

For the required smallest-instance check, if \(n=4\) then \(k=1\).  The capsule chooses one treated focal unit, one distinct control focal unit, and fair-coins the other two.  Hence the total treated count has law \(1+\operatorname{Binomial}(2,1/2)\), supported on \(\{1,2,3\}\), rather than being fixed at two.  Enumeration of the twelve ordered focal pairs and both arm labels verifies (27) is unbiased, but refutes the original description as a standard fixed balanced two-arm assignment.  This is exactly why the statement has been narrowed while retaining its valid rate assertion.
body.justification: This verifies that the construction reduces to an explicit no-interference two-stage design when radius-two conflicts disappear.
body.gap: The reduction is a required sanity check rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It lets users interpret the degree-dependent frontier as the exact inflation over ordinary randomized experimentation.
